questions.question: Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct: 18 × 12 - 51 ÷ 34 + 17 = 185

18 × 12 - 51 ÷ 34 + 17 = 185

18 × 12 - 51 ÷ 34 + 17 = 185

18 - 12 × 17 ÷ 34 + 51 

= 18 - 12 × 0.5 + 51

= 18 - 6 + 51

= 69 - 6

= 63 ≠ 185

2) 51 and 17, × and ÷ 

18 × 12 - 51 ÷ 34 + 17 = 185

Interchanging the signs and numbers and using BODMAS rule:-

18 ÷ 12 - 17 × 34 + 51

= 1.5 - 17 × 34 + 51

= 1.5 - 578 + 51

= 52.5 - 578

= - 525.5 ≠ 185

3) 34 and 51, × and + 

18 × 12 - 51 ÷ 34 + 17 = 185

Interchanging the signs and numbers and using BODMAS rule:-

18 + 12 - 34 ÷ 51 × 17

= 18 + 12 - 0.67 × 17

= 18 + 12 - 11.33

= 30 - 11.33

= 18.67 ≠ 185

**4) 34 and 51, + and ÷ **

**18 × 12 - 51 ÷ 34 + 17 = 185**

**Interchanging the signs and numbers and using BODMAS rule:-**

**18 × 12 - 34 + 51 ÷ 17 **

**= 18 × 12 - 34 + 3**

**= 216 - 34 + 3**

**= 219 - 34**

**= 185 = 185**
